# Fixture Draft Single Source

Check 6 fixture: a draft note whose ONLY source is one book work, cited via the parent
note plus two of its chapters. Under the old occurrence-counting logic this was 3 sourced
wikilinks (>= min_sources) and wrongly flagged promote-to-final; under distinct-source
logic the parent + chapters collapse to ONE work, so it must NOT be promoted.
